translations.answer: Not necessarily. The maintainer's note indicates that qpOASES_e uses static memory with a default compile-time limit of 50 variables and 100 constraints. First, compare the actual nV/nC with QPOASES_NVMAX and QPOASES_NCMAX; if it exceeds the limit, modify `include/qpOASES_e/Constants.h` and recompile. Since the original post does not provide a recompiled author's verification, the memory usage and solution result must still be validated on the target hardware.
translations.applicability: Directly corresponds to the default configuration of qpOASES_e 3.1.1; packages or forks may have modified macro values, so refer to the actual build header file.
translations.credibility.rationale: The environment, processing steps, and results have engineering records, but formal cross-validation or independent replication is missing.
translations.details.attempts.0: The original post used other MATLAB solvers to cross-check the problem's feasibility.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Print the compile-time `QPOASES_NVMAX` and `QPOASES_NCMAX` before analyzing the model's feasibility.
translations.details.effective_fixes.0: Increase the two upper limits in `include/qpOASES_e/Constants.h` and recompile all code dependent on this header file.
translations.details.environments.0: qpOASES_e 3.1.1; the original report worked within 49 variables / 68 constraints, but failed when increased.
translations.details.limits.0: Increasing the static limit will increase memory usage; if it exceeds the new limit or fails, further verification of real feasibility and input layout is required.
translations.details.outcomes.0: The maintainer provides clear configuration information and marks the issue as fixed; no author recompiled verification is provided.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: qpOASES_e reports infeasible after increasing the number of QP variables or constraints, is this due to default scale limits?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Before modifying the static limit on the embedded target, evaluate RAM/stack, and add static nV/nC assertions during build.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: The maintainer confirms that qpOASES_e uses static memory with a default maximum of 50 variables and 100 constraints.
translations.details.symptoms.0: Initialization returns infeasible, but other MATLAB solvers can solve the same problem; the issue occurs near 50 variables.
translations.source.title: qpOASES_e exceeds default static dimension limit, appears as infeasible, is this always due to an infeasible QP?
translations.title: qpOASES_e starts reporting infeasible when the number of variables approaches 50, is this always due to an infeasible QP?
